Chhattisgarh Christian Forum Official Held for Remarks on Hindu Deities

An First Information Report (FIR) has been filed against two individuals, including the president of the Chhattisgarh Christian Forum, for allegedly making derogatory remarks about Hindu deities. One office-bearer of the forum has been held in connection with an 'objectionable' social media post concerning Lord Shiva. The FIR specifically names the Chhattisgarh Christian Forum president.
